::: {#def-covariate-pattern}

#### Covariate pattern

A **covariate pattern** is a distinct value of the predictor vector among the observations $\vpredvar_1, \dots, \vpredvar_\nobs$.
The $\npatterns$ distinct values are written $\vpredvar^{(1)}, \dots, \vpredvar^{(\npatterns)}$, so $\npatterns \le \nobs$.

:::
